summary_en: Daikin raised interim dividend by 5 yen to 185 yen per share for the period ending September 30, 2026, and revised upward the year-end dividend forecast by 5 yen to 185 yen, bringing total dividend for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 to 370 yen, reflecting record interim sales and operating profit.
title_en: Notice Regarding Surplus Dividend (Dividend Increase) and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast
translation_en_brief:
On November 5, 2026, Daikin Industries resolved to raise its interim dividend to 185 yen per share, up 5 yen from the prior forecast of 180 yen, for the period with record date September 30, 2026. The company simultaneously revised upward its year-end dividend forecast to 185 yen per share, also up 5 yen from the prior forecast of 180 yen, bringing the total annual dividend for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 to 370 yen, compared with 360 yen previously forecasted.

The increases reflect results for the second quarter of fiscal 2027 (cumulative through September 2026), which achieved record high sales and operating profit. The company also announced upward revisions to full-year earnings guidance on the same date, prompting the modification to year-end dividend expectations.

Daikin stated its basic dividend policy emphasizes stability and continuous dividend growth while maintaining awareness of the payout ratio in light of historical dividend track record. The interim dividend of 185 yen matches the prior year level, while the year-end dividend of 185 yen exceeds the prior-year year-end dividend of 175 yen.
